- noise at the boil: how loud the kettle is at the boil, as measured by a named test. 1 = a measured level above 70 dB(A); 3 = 55 to 70 dB(A); 5 = below 55 dB(A). - Two kettles are identical on everything except that one stocks spare parts for longer. Do you prefer it, or are you indifferent?
